odc_type: unhandled convergence exception in numerical approximation
observation_summary: The application throws a MaxIterationsExceededException when calculating the cumulative probability for extreme input values.
reasoning_summary: The code uses an iterative numerical method (via the error function) to calculate the cumulative probability of a normal distribution. For extreme input values (far from the mean), the iterative algorithm fails to converge within the specified iteration limit, throwing a MaxIterationsExceededException. The fix introduces a try-catch block to handle this exception by returning the mathematically expected limit values (0.0 or 1.0) when the input is sufficiently far from the mean, rather than allowing the exception to propagate and crash the calculation.
